visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with brown hair tied back, wearing a navy blue sweater, a pink face mask, and a beige apron featuring the brand logo '正香鮮', stands in an indoor retail environment. She gestures with her hands as if speaking, looking slightly off-camera. The background shows a table with an 'Uber Eats' sign and indoor plants. (2) A close-up shot transitions to hands in white gloves using a metal spatula to spread fresh, pale-colored fish paste on a metal tray, placing a wedge of hard-boiled egg in the center. (3) The scene shifts to a large metal deep fryer filled with bubbling dark brown oil. Elongated, golden-brown fish cakes are seen frying and being stirred with a large metal slotted spoon. (4) A medium shot shows the finished fish cakes, now vibrant golden-yellow, resting on a metal wire rack inside a display case. (5) Various skewers of fried snacks are presented in a brown paper cup. A skewer is held up to show a cross-section of a fish cake with a visible white and yellow egg center. (6) The woman uses metal tongs to pick up fried items and place them into a white cardboard takeaway box. (7) A high-angle shot shows a large pile of fluffy, orange-brown shredded fish floss being moved by tongs. (8) A hand opens a clear glass freezer door and pulls out a colorful plastic bag of frozen fish products. (9) The camera pans across the interior of the shop, decorated with red lanterns and a brick-patterned counter, then cuts to an outdoor street shot of the storefront under a red and white striped awning with several traffic lights in the background.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator in apron; various hands in gloves for preparation.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman in her 30s with brown hair, wearing a navy blue long-sleeved sweater and a beige apron with traditional Chinese characters and a fish logo. She wears a pink surgical mask.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The indoor scenes feature a clean market-style stall with a glass display case, traditional red lanterns, and a brick-pattern wall. The outdoor scene shows a street corner in Taiwan with typical traffic signals and multi-story buildings.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking in a friendly, conversational Mandarin tone about the longevity of the brand. Upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic pop music with a prominent guitar rhythm starts simultaneously. (2) A male narrator's voice takes over, exhibiting high clarity and professional articulation. He describes the hand-making process of the fish paste. The BGM remains steady. (3) A distinct broadband sizzling sound is introduced as the narration mentions the frying process, simulating the sound of hot oil. The male voice maintains an energetic, positive valence. (4) The narrator lists various products with rhythmic emphasis, synchronized with visual cuts. Subtle UI 'pop' sound effects occur during text overlays. (5) The male narrator's arousal level increases slightly as he highlights the fish floss and frozen packs, urging viewers to try them. The BGM continues until a hard cut at the very end of the video signal.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Brand Intro -> Manufacturing Process -> Product Menu -> Purchasing Options -> Location Call-to-action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the Taiwanese snack brand '正香鮮' by showcasing its traditional hand-made fish cakes (旗魚黑輪). It leverages the brand's 30-year history and emphasizes quality ingredients like fresh fish paste and local eggs. The fast-paced montage of sizzling food and diverse menu items is designed to stimulate appetite and drive traffic to their Kaohsiung locations.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features the store owner speaking, constant logo overlays, detailed product close-ups, and ends with specific store addresses and a call to purchase.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality production combining professional voice-over and crisp food photography. Effective use of localized Kaohsiung context.
